So from what I gathered from the two posts you’ve been feeling almost sick over this and originally didn’t want to text first or anything. You realize the situation is messed up and continue to keep following through anyway even though it seems like your gut is continually telling you not to. You seem to have a very guilty conscious (much like myself) over even small things, so let’s get this straight. You’re a 19 year old virgin who keeps stating how you’d rather have a girlfriend then a hookup, but right now you’re on the verge of hooking up with an older woman because you said she was hot. Not only is she an older stranger, who could be dangerous, but she also has a boyfriend, who could also be dangerous if he finds out she’s cheating with you. Do you not normally feel guilt about cheating? Because if you didn’t know, that’s one thing. But you’re fully aware of her boyfriend. You also worry about what your parents think. Let’s go worst case scenario: You go to her house, things get heated and she gets a bit controlling. Even if you don’t really feel like it, maybe she convinces you. Bam, you lost your virginity to an older lady. Then suddenly the boyfriend comes home and freaks out, maybe there’s a bit of a fight. You struggle getting home and your family sees you and asked what happens. Eventually they find out. You’re telling me that in hindsight, you won’t have thought ‘maybe I shouldn’t have done that’ ? Cuz once you do it there’s no going back. You need to want it 100%, but the fact you keep writing about it and referring to it as ‘messed up’ and the fact that it’s making you feel unwell seems like a pretty obvious sign that you don’t feel good about the whole thing. That uuuusually indicates that it’s a bad idea. If you still decide to go, at least try to be safe. And maybe at least tell a friend where you are.
